title: [AUG-177] Research: in-progress spinner after transcript processing reaches 100%
why_we_need_this: Rodion's feedback (Feature Request 2): on the EXTERMINATUS INITIATED processing screen, once the progress hits 00:00:00 / 100% there is no sign that work is still going on, so it looks frozen. He wants a spinner/animation until the process fully ends, in August's visual style. Source: @docs/feedback/2026-11-rodion-feedback.md
acceptance_criteria:
- [ ] Stages that run after 100% listed with file:line refs (merge, semantic pass, corrections, cleanup) and how long they typically take.
- [ ] Options compared: generic spinner vs named post-processing stage text vs both; reduced-motion handling.
- [ ] HTML mockup: a self-contained file @docs/mockups/AUG-177/processing-spinner.html (opens in a browser, no build) with the EXTERMINATUS INITIATED screen in its post-100% state and 2–3 animated spinner variants in August style, plus the reduced-motion fallback; built on August's real design tokens (frontend-design route, 0 border-radius).
- [ ] The user picks a variant on the mockup (AskUserQuestion); the decision is recorded in this card.
- [ ] CLOSURE CONDITION: an implementation task with the agreed scope, SMART acceptance criteria and a link to the chosen mockup is created on the board; its ID is written into this card and into the roadmap line in @project-context/roadmap/README.md.
important_constraints: Research only — no code changes. Closed only by creating the agreed implementation task. No diagnostics (method names, timings) in user UI. Roadmap: M2 Live session control. Order: 8/10.
